title: Recall: Implement a shared behavior contract
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

implementation.clue: Given trait Named { fn name(&self) -> &str; } and struct User { name: String }, write the complete trait implementation returning a shared borrow of the name field.

greeting.clue: Inside fn greeting<T: Named>(value: &T) -> String, write the format expression producing hello followed by one space and value.name(), using one positional {} placeholder.
